name: hud_sensor_tracker_on_objective_read_sound_event
description: HudSensorTracker::OnObjectiveReadSoundEvent handles objective read-sound callback events for showing or hiding objective review and restoring HUD sound volume. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudSensor objective/HUD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x419380 validates fastcall ECX=eventCode, event 0 calls g_HudSensorTracker.SetObjectiveReviewVisible(1), event 1 calls SetObjectiveReviewVisible(0), event 2 restores zSnd global volume from g_HudSensorTracker.hudScale and enables flag-10 playback, and other events return without side effects.
The native HudSensor objective-panel smoke verifies event 0 show, event 1 hide, event 2 volume/playback restoration, and ignored unknown events.
